QUESTIONS.question: You are tasked with inspecting the fuel injector for wear on a MAN 16V175D‑MM engine. Describe the step‑by‑step procedure you would follow, including any tools required, and how you would document findings.
QUESTIONS.expected_answer: 1. Depressurize and isolate the fuel system. 2. Remove the injector using the specified torque‑rated socket. 3. Record measurements, visual observations, and part number in the maintenance log.
QUESTIONS.explanation: Following a systematic inspection ensures safety, accurate assessment, and proper documentation for future reference.
